metadata.description: nappozord's Claude Code plugins: mods, hooks, skills and commands.

plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: A band above the prompt: folder and branch, prompts and cost, context window, 5-hour and weekly limits, cache countdown, session time and tokens.

plugins.name: no-push-guard
plugins.description: Denies every git push (including force and dry-run): pushing is always done by the user.

plugins.name: no-coauthor
plugins.description: Keeps Claude out of commit and PR attribution: no co-author or 'Generated with' lines.
